priority_policy: partition x-then-y sorted 40 class points by order-five residue; visit nonempty residues in ascending residue number round-robin, ascending point index within residue
relation_policy: degree-2/5 base plus direct and Hecke support<=4; then direct and Hecke support5; compare source-prefix rational rank for support4 and support4+direct5 baselines

selection.order_rule: 5 divides #E(Fp), 5 does not divide p-1, largest prime divisor of #E(Fp) >=53

source_stop: first rational rank40 for both baselines or 40 sources
